review_candidates.title: Senior Software Tester Automation Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Senior Software Tester Automation Engineer (Banking Background) Summary/Purpose: The Senior Software Automation Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust automation solutions for banking applications while ensuring high software quality, reliability, and compliance with industry standards. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks and scripts for banking applications. Define and implement automation testing
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role requires strong expertise in automation frameworks, software engineering, API and UI automation, CI/CD integration, and banking domain knowledge. Define and implement automation testing strategies, standards, and best practices aligned with banking compliance requirements. - 5+ years of experience in software automation testing, including at least 3 years of hands-on automation engineering experience. - Expertise in writing scalable test scripts using Java, Python, JavaScript, or other programming languages. - Proficiency in API testing tools like Postman or RestAssured.
